mapper.sql: r.process_id,r.factory_id,(SELECT factory_name FROM metal_factory WHERE factory_id=r.factory_id) factory_name,r.process_name,r.description,r.process_type,(SELECT type_name FROM metal_process_type WHERE type_id=r.process_type) process_type_name,r.create_by,r.create_time,r.update_by,r.update_time,r.version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM metal_process r WHERE r.del_flag='0' AND r.factory_id IS NOT NULL AND r.factory_id=#{factoryId} ORDER BY r.process_id ASC
SELECT FROM metal_process r WHERE r.del_flag='0' AND r.process_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM metal_process r WHERE r.del_flag='0' AND r.process_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE metal_process SET process_name=#{name},description=#{description},process_type=#{processType},version=version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW() WHERE process_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND del_flag='0'
UPDATE metal_process SET del_flag='2',version=version+1,update_by=#{actor},update_time=NOW() WHERE process_id=#{id} AND del_flag='0'
